A small style-guide correction to the banner and README hero. No functional
changes to upload, download, expiry, or password handling.

## Changed

- **White banner** — the banner is now the canonical white `#ffffff` 1600×500
  card with the gold feather centered and no text, replacing the transparent
  emblem crop that shipped in 1.0.2. The wordmark lives in the heading.
- **README hero reordered** to the canonical style-guide sequence: centered
  `<h1>` → tagline (a featherdrop-specific exception) → banner → badge row →
  description. The full description moved back below the badges.
